Before you start

  • You need step 5.6 (Check the site follows the defaults).

Steps

Session
Master Data➔Items➔Items (tcibd0501m000)

Why LN works this way. When you save, LN gives the item its group's supply source, units and item data. If Sites was ticked in the defaults, it adds a site row too. The site row is where you check the defaults worked. That's why you don't type what LN fills in: a value you type would hide a mistake in the defaults.

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
LN won't take the item codeChoose a code that follows your company's pattern for item codes. Don't change the pattern for a test
The code goes into the project box, or General Projects opensClose it without making a project. Clear both boxes and type the code in the second
The save is refused for a field this guide doesn't nameWrite down the field and the message, then fill it in. Don't clear another field to make it save
Create Items by Site makes no rowClick New on the Sites toolbar, choose your site, and save
A kind of item data is missing after you saveCheck the defaults: Set the defaults for bought items for a bought item, Set the defaults for made items for the made one, and Check the site follows the defaults for both
The supply source isn't the one the group givesThe item or the site may have its own value, or one that starts on a later date. Check those before you change the defaults

Create test items
Create the three items

  1. This task starts at Master Data➔Items➔Items (tcibd0501m000)

    Click New

    You should see

    Item (tcibd0501m100) opens, empty. It can take half a minute

  2. Item has two boxes

    Leave the first, for a project, empty. Type the first bought item's code in the second

    Example
    Item BAM-ROD
    Copy    , then BAM-SLEEVE
    Copy    , then BAM-CHOP-PAIR
    Copy
    Write down

  3. Click into Description and enter one

    Example
    Description Bamboo Rod, then Paper Sleeve, then Bamboo Chopstick Pair

  4. Check Item Type

    You should see

    Product

  5. Click into Item Group and enter the item's group from Create two item groups

    You should see

    Unit Set and Unit fill in

  6. Fill in any other field the screen says is needed

  7. Click Save

    You should see

    The item is saved, and the Subentities indicators of its group turn green

  8. Look at the Sites grid

    You should see

    A row for your site, with Default Supply Source filled in. The top row, marked =, is a filter, not a site

  9. If there's no row for your site, choose Create Items by Site from the Sites tab's menu

    You should see

    A row for your site

  10. Open your site's row with the arrow at its start

    You should see

    Items by Site (tcibd1550m000) opens for this item and site

  11. Check Default Supply Source

    You should see

    Purchase for a bought item, Job Shop for a made one

  12. Check which kinds of item data are on

    You should see

    Ordering, Purchase and Warehousing for a bought item. Ordering, Production, Warehousing and Sales for a made one

  13. Do steps 1 to 12 for the second bought item, then for the made item

    You should see

    Each item's site row matches its group

Nobody has confirmed this step in LN yet.

  • Kept in this browser until you start a new run.

    • LN won't take the item code

      Choose a code that follows your company's pattern for item codes. Don't change the pattern for a test

    • The code goes into the project box, or General Projects opens

      Close it without making a project. Clear both boxes and type the code in the second

    • The save is refused for a field this guide doesn't name

      Write down the field and the message, then fill it in. Don't clear another field to make it save

    • Create Items by Site makes no row

      Click New on the Sites toolbar, choose your site, and save

    • A kind of item data is missing after you save

      Check the defaults: Set the defaults for bought items for a bought item, Set the defaults for made items for the made one, and Check the site follows the defaults for both

    • The supply source isn't the one the group gives

      The item or the site may have its own value, or one that starts on a later date. Check those before you change the defaults

  • When you save, LN gives the item its group's supply source, units and item data. If Sites was ticked in the defaults, it adds a site row too. The site row is where you check the defaults worked. That's why you don't type what LN fills in: a value you type would hide a mistake in the defaults.
